messages:
harry: Opening a short follow-up from the infra segment - APAC GPU bias, autoscaler fallbacks, and comms. Post quick Qs here.

leah: When we say 'bias APAC', are we moving unassigned hosted capacity only or preempting anything else?

devops: Only unallocated/hosted pooled capacity. No changes to Dedicated or Private reservations. If a potential conflict appears we'll notify account teams before any reassignments.

sasha: What's the practical fallback order if APAC runs low?

devops: Fallback order: 1) local spare pool in same AZ, 2) nearby region (latency guardrails), 3) model-variant fallback (quantized/smaller), 4) degrade non-critical features (async).

product: At what point do we flip from "bias" to "hard reservation" for a region? product needs numbers.

devops: Two signals: sustained region utilization > 85% for 12h AND predicted buffer < 10% for next 14 days. When both tripped -> escalate to reservation mode and notify sales ops.

ops-bot: event-id: infra-autoscale-1895007810; note: cross-region routing triggered for hosted-apac-prod -> 47 reqs to us-west-2.

leah: Warm pools - what's default per-region? engineers care about cold-starts.

devops: Defaults: critical routes = 4 warm GPUs, standard = 2. Tenants can request higher warm reservoirs via policy knobs or committed reservations.

sasha: Quantized fallbacks: how do we detect regressions?

devops: Canary on <=5% traffic; embedding/regression checks run continuously. Auto-rollback if drift > 0.07 avg or if structured-output failures exceed threshold.

harry: Can we get a 1-2 line blurb for infra status + a customer region-lock template?

devops: Drafting both — status blurb will note: "Temporarily biasing hosted capacity to APAC while additional GPU shipments arrive (mid-June, mid-July windows). Fallbacks include regional routing and model-variant fallbacks; Dedicated/Private unaffected. Request region isolation via support." Will post to infra status today.

product: Thanks. Please include analytic labels so product can filter cross-region latency metrics (region_requested, region_served, fallback_reason).

devops: Added to observability schema.

harry: Great thread. If we missed anything ping @devops or me and we'll add to the all-hands notes.

leah: :thumbsup:
